newsitem.title: USA: Santa Clara, Calif., voters approve tax measures.
newsitem.headline: Santa Clara, Calif., voters approve tax measures.

text.p: Santa Clara County voters approved a half-cent sales tax increase that would raise $1.1 billion over nine years to fund transportation improvements, election officials said Wednesday.
The tax measures were closely watched by local governments across the state because of their controversial structure.

Last year, the California state Supreme Court ruled that Santa Clara's one-half cent transportation sales tax was invalid. That measure, which received 54 percent voter approval, would have extended the life of a 1984 one-half cent sales tax increase to fund transportation projects.
